newsitem.title: USA: Strouds December same-store sales flat.
newsitem.headline: Strouds December same-store sales flat.

text.p: Strouds Inc Thursday reported sales of approximately $27.4 million for the five week period ended January 4, 1997, compared with approximately $23 million for the same period last year, and said comparable store sales for the December period were flat.

Net sales for the 44 weeks ended January 4 were approximately $178.3 million compared with approximately $157.5 million for the same period last year. Strouds said year-to-date comparable store sales have increased by approximately 1.3 percent.
